title: Loy Krathong
paragraphs: Loy Krathong is a Thai festival where people float decorated baskets (krathongs) on water to give thanks and symbolically let go of misfortune. The festival typically occurs on the full moon of the 12th lunar month.
Krathongs are traditionally made from banana leaves, flowers, candles, and incense. The gentle lights on rivers and ponds create one of Thailand’s most picturesque celebrations.
